review_method: Source-only comparison with the existing C3 site/chunk encoder and pooling implementation, plus inspection of the sealed author measurement. No tests or numerical probes rerun by reviewer.

checks.detail: For every called site/allele, donor log frequencies, donor availability, panel log frequency, entropy and called flag match the existing15D input; observed haplotype identity is absent from that MLP input.
Unavailable donor channels are zeroed while availability flags retain the original mask. Allele-category batching does not change reference statistics.
Negative calls map safely to category0 but called=false excludes them from sums, maxima, counts and every MLP parameter gradient, matching the original operator.
Unused slots substitute panel probability1 before log and then zero their entire feature row; this keeps padded zero-probability rows finite without changing any active-category input.
Allele count is taken from the authenticated donor tensor axis, with original gather bounds; no binary-only or ancestry-class substitution is introduced.
The adapter iterates the same source chunks and unique_consecutive hold mapping, gathers into original site/haplotype order, and retains persistent sample output rows.
Both per-chunk and cross-chunk index_add/scatter_reduce amax recipes match the original order, masks, max ties and count treatment.
Mean/count/empty/span normalizations and the current site_pool_projection are unchanged.

Gather backward sums every original use into the shared category encoding before the same MLP backward. No detach, manual gradient averaging or numeric-equality cache is used; preserving original max reductions retains tie behavior.
category_encoded is local and model.site_mlp is evaluated on every call. Only observed-input construction is factored; there is no retained learned state across calls or optimizer updates.
The current Linear/GELU/Linear/Tanh MLP has no dropout or batch-dependent operation. Exact factoring is scoped to that contract; a future changed MLP would need reevaluation.

The prototype is isolated and read-only with respect to live sources. Its diagnostic pooling adapter omits the existing training checkpoint wrapper; production checkpoint/recompute, memory and whole-update CUDA qualification remain open and are not claimed.

limitations: One observed TRAIN000 start slice and saved94 checkpoint; reported parameter gradients are weighted sum/max probes, not complete-model training gradients.
The terminal source chunk omits neighboring holds; no full-parent floating-kernel parity claim.
CPU encoder timings do not establish GPU, whole-update, preparation or end-to-end speedups.
No production integration, held-out ancestry/boundary score, superiority or novelty claim.
